realtime_observation_unavailable.title: Realtime Rachio observation is unavailable
realtime_observation_unavailable.description: IrrigationOS could not enable realtime Rachio events: {reason}. Five-minute polling remains active. Configure an externally reachable HTTPS Home Assistant URL to enable push updates; Home Assistant Cloud is optional.

user.title: Connect IrrigationOS to Rachio
user.description: In the Rachio app, open Profile, select API Key, and tap Copy. Paste the key below. IrrigationOS validates the account before setup and starts in Observation mode.

confirm.title: Review discovered irrigation hardware
confirm.description: IrrigationOS found {controller_count} controller(s) and {area_count} irrigation area(s). Controllers: {controller_names}. Areas: {area_names}. Submit to finish setup in Observation mode.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect IrrigationOS to Rachio
reauth_confirm.description: Enter a current Rachio API key for this same account.

error.invalid_response: Rachio returned an unexpected account response.
error.rate_limited: Rachio is temporarily rate limiting requests. Try again shortly.

abort.already_configured: This Rachio account is already configured.
abort.wrong_account: The API key belongs to a different Rachio account.

init.title: IrrigationOS options
init.description: Choose a supervised operator workflow. The first-live trial path is interactive and single-use; it does not create a Home Assistant service or button.

area.title: Edit landscape profile
area.description: Edit the Landscape Digital Twin profile for {area_name}. Controller observations remain separate from these landscape facts.

landscape.title: Landscape Digital Twin
landscape.description: Select an irrigation area to review or edit.

commissioning.title: Commission generic zone knowledge
commissioning.description: Select a canonical configured irrigation area and how its landscape knowledge will be supplied. This records advisory evidence only and cannot water the area.

commissioning_simple.title: Simple guided zone setup
commissioning_simple.description: Choose an irrigation area. You will describe it in ordinary language; IrrigationOS will create canonical evidence for review before saving.

manage_zones.title: Manage zones
manage_zones.description: Choose the zone you want to set up, update, observe, or review.

manage_zone.title: {zone_name}
manage_zone.description: Setup status: {status}. Choose what you want to do. A temporary run requires this explicit selection every time and never enables automatic watering.

data.manage_zone_action: What would you like to do?

manage_zone_photos.title: Add zone photos
manage_zone_photos.description: Choose one or more images from Home Assistant media. IrrigationOS stores only private opaque references, not image bytes.

data.zone_photo_running: Taken while this zone was watering

manage_zone_plant.title: Which plant group would you like to update?
manage_zone_plant.description: Choose by name. Advanced identifiers remain hidden.

commissioning_simple_input.title: Tell us about this zone
commissioning_simple_input.description: Describe what you know. Approximate observations are welcome; unknown values remain unknown and this cannot water the zone.

data.simple_description: Describe the plants and how they are watered
data.simple_planted_date: About when was it planted? YYYY-MM-DD (optional)
data.simple_sharing: Does delivery serve one plant or several?

commissioning_input.title: Record commissioned zone evidence
commissioning_input.description: Save structured zone evidence. Baseline values are not weather-scaled, visual records must already be approved, conflicts remain unresolved, and no execution authority is granted.

data.commissioning_reference_et0_mm: Reference ET₀ for the calibration period (mm, optional)

commissioning_review_select.title: Review commissioned zone
commissioning_review_select.description: Select a canonical commissioned zone. Detailed facts remain outside Recorder-facing entity attributes.

commissioning_add_plant.title: Add plant group
commissioning_add_plant.description: Add one user-confirmed plant group without replacing existing plants. Missing delivery information remains an advisory.

commissioning_edit_plant.title: Edit plant group
commissioning_edit_plant.description: Scientifically relevant changes retain the previous plant facts as an immutable history event.

commissioning_remove_plant.title: Remove plant group
commissioning_remove_plant.description: The plant leaves current state, but its complete prior facts remain in immutable landscape history.

commissioning_delivery.title: Edit irrigation-delivery link
commissioning_delivery.description: Record only known canonical delivery associations. IrrigationOS will not infer hydraulic properties.

commissioning_baseline.title: Review calibrated baseline
commissioning_baseline.description: This records the user's reference runtime and conditions only. No weather scaling or watering calculation occurs.

data.commissioning_reference_et0_mm: Reference ET₀ for the calibration period (mm, optional)

commissioning_baseline_reference.title: Capture current baseline reference
commissioning_baseline_reference.description: Capture an exact normalized dry environmental period. ET₀ is measured evidence, never derived from temperature. Blockers: {blockers}

data.commissioning_capture_dry_confirmation: Confirm this is a representative dry reference condition
data.commissioning_replace_reference_confirma: Confirm replacement of any current reference

commissioning_delivery_calibration.title: Calibrate irrigation delivery
commissioning_delivery_calibration.description: Record only observed, rated, estimated, or measured component evidence. Unknown values remain unknown and no runtime is calculated.

data.commissioning_radius_meters: Observed or estimated radius in meters (optional)

first_live_trial.title: Supervised first-live watering trial
first_live_trial.description: Current commissioning status: {commissioning_status}. Select exactly one observed Rachio zone and a runtime of 1-120 seconds. To authorize this single supervised attempt, type exactly: {confirmation_phrase}

error.invalid_profile: One or more landscape profile values are outside the allowed range.
error.invalid_commissioning_input: The commissioning evidence is incomplete, inconsistent, or invalid.
error.commissioning_persistence_failed: The commissioning evidence could not be saved. No new zone knowledge was activated.
error.invalid_commissioning_edit: The requested commissioning edit is incomplete or inconsistent. Existing evidence was not changed.
error.commissioning_removal_not_confirmed: Plant removal was not explicitly confirmed.
error.baseline_reference_capture_blocked: The environmental reference could not be captured. No baseline evidence was changed. Blockers: {blockers}
error.invalid_delivery_calibration: The delivery calibration is incomplete or inconsistent. Existing evidence was not changed.
error.first_live_confirmation_mismatch: The exact supervised-trial confirmation phrase was not entered.
error.first_live_trial_invalid: The selected trial target or request is no longer valid.

abort.no_areas: No irrigation areas are currently available.
abort.no_commissioned_zones: No commissioned zones are currently available for review.
abort.no_first_live_targets: No configured irrigation zones are currently available for a supervised trial.
abort.first_live_trial_start_dispatched: The one-shot start command was accepted for {runtime_seconds} seconds. Blockers: {blockers}. The approval and commissioning window are now closed.
abort.first_live_trial_blocked: The supervised trial was blocked. Blockers: {blockers}. No watering command was dispatched.
abort.first_live_trial_transport_outcome_unkno: The transport outcome could not be confirmed. Blockers: {blockers}. Approval was consumed and automatic retry is prohibited.
